name: Refractor Field
effect: While the field is active, the user automatically fails most Stealth Tests.

name: Conversion Field
effect: If the Conversion Field reduces 10 or more Damage from a single attack, it inflicts the Blinded Condition on all creatures in the Zone for one round. This does not affect the user.

name: Icon of the Just
effect: Daemons or creatures with a Warp Threshold have a -20 penalty to Tests against the bearer.
